rules.title: Program rules
rules.review: Anyone can propose outreach; the team reviews each proposal before any allocation.
rules.discretion: Allocations are at the team's discretion: it decides whether to approve outreach, when to send CST and how much. Outreach that isn't approved receives nothing.
rules.excluded: Spam, bought followers or engagement, and misleading claims, including claims about what CST is worth, don't count.
rules.disclose: Say that you may receive CST whenever you post about Cosmic Signature.
